project.name: web
project.description: Undercurrents: eighteen years of Tame Impala setlists, venues and tours, read through predictive models that always show their score against the simplest baseline that could beat them.

boards.name: redesign
boards.title: Redesign
boards.description: The portal rebuilt to the craft bar: shell, one analysis page, one prediction page.

frames.title: Night Notes
frames.description: A dense analysis page rebuilt to the craft bar: one real chart instead of hand-drawn bars, drawn icons, and figures set in sentences rather than as oversized stat heroes.

frames.title: Landing - poster
frames.description: Landing direction A: the record sleeve. One photograph carries the page, the figures sit under it as a quiet strip rather than as oversized stat heroes.

frames.title: Landing - archive index
frames.description: Landing direction B: the archive index. The two halves of the product are the page, the photograph is evidence beside them rather than a backdrop behind everything.

frames.title: Navigation
frames.description: The two-section tab system, rebuilt without the 01-13 numbering the page order never justified, and with the section accent doing the work the numbers were doing.

frames.title: Encore
frames.description: A prediction page rebuilt to the craft bar: the shipped method, the score it earned on held-out shows, and the simpler rule that beat it, all readable without a legend.
